reasons: Analytical child/household records link survey identifiers and district/sample geography to individual anaemia and stunting responses.
District fitting inputs retain direct proportions and sample counts; some observed district endpoints have a single child, so an unchanged release can disclose a health response.
Suppressing or changing those records would change the fitting inputs used in the article.
excluded_data_classes: Direct district outcomes and respondent counts
review_scope: Content and provenance of the actual principal inputs, assessed separately from the earlier 35 derived reproduction CSVs.
approved_auxiliary_scope: District aggregate census, geographic and poverty covariates only; no ENDES responses, respondent identifiers or ENDES respondent counts.

provenance_caveats.aux_all_districts.csv: Recorded author-supplied aggregate compilation; original source-status flags disclose unverified extraction and census queries not independently re-executed. Not a fresh official census extraction.
provenance_caveats.aux_sikov14_official.csv: Historical district aggregate predictors assembled by align_aux_sikov.py from recorded official census/geographic inputs without reading ENDES responses.

raw_acquisition: Readers obtain the official INEI microdata independently and retain/process them outside the Git repository. Public availability is distinct from this review finding no sensitive content.
additional_prerequisites: Complete reviewed scientific source/reference trees, protocol metadata, census query tables, original preparation references, R, CmdStan and external output directories.

validation.limitations: Principal records and direct-outcome fitting basis remain excluded; full model pipeline still requires the documented external reference prerequisites.
